items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I used to follow either follow each other like Pats Waller was using, was in the same studio a lot.

ctx.x: I used to follow either follow each other like Pats Waller was using, was in the same studio a lot. Tommy Dorsey was in the same studio a lot. You know, follow each other one way or the other.

I used to go down there like when we played the Paramount or the Strand. We'd finish the show at 11:00. We was down there recording at 1:00 at night. And, they practically let me record practically anything I want.
